title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Container, Weight and Booking Limits per Category
content:
The limits below are the quantitative ceilings of Dangerous Goods Acceptance. They bound one acceptance (its containers and its hazardous gross weight), one customer's share of a sailing, and the number of live acceptances a booking may carry. Weights are kilograms of dangerous-goods gross weight.

| Category | Containers per acceptance, at most | Gross kg per container, at most | Gross kg per acceptance, at most | Per customer and sailing: containers of the category accepted or awaiting a decision | Live acceptances on one booking while this category is among them | May share a booking with an acceptance of another category |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 10 | 24000 | 120000 | 20 | 5 | Yes |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 10 | 26000 | 160000 | 15 | 3 | Yes |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 8 | 24000 | 120000 | 10 | 3 | Yes |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 5 | 22000 | 80000 | 6 | 1 | No |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 5 | 20000 | 60000 | 6 | 1 | No |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 2 | 18000 | 20000 | 2 | 1 | No |

## What each column measures

- **Containers per acceptance** and **gross kg per acceptance** are ceilings on a single acceptance record.
- **Gross kg per container** is a ceiling per box.
- **Containers on a sailing** counts, for one customer, the containers of this same category that are accepted or still pending on one vessel voyage.
- **Live acceptances on one booking** is the largest number of live acceptances a booking may hold while an acceptance of this category is one of them.
- **May share a booking** records whether a booking holding this category may also hold a dangerous-goods acceptance of a different category.

## Observations drawn from the table

The three categories marked No in the last column are also the three whose booking ceiling is 1. AHL DG Special Approval allows two containers per acceptance but only 20000 kg for the whole acceptance, which is less than the combined per-box figure of two containers.
